title: Mapping how LLMs debate societal issues when shadowing human personality traits, sociodemographics and social media behavior
reasoning: The paper introduces a dataset (CDS) that specifically includes 'religious beliefs' as one of the 17 persona attributes used to condition LLM responses. Furthermore, the authors state that debate topics were selected based on their relevance to 'moral reasoning'. The framework is designed to audit LLM bias and sensitivity across these dimensions.
